facts.fact: AUDA-NEPAD launched its Programme for African Developing Island Economies on 24 July 2026 at the STC-TTIM Ministerial Segment in Abidjan, with the Comoros named among the seven member island states joining a framework that has digital transformation as one of six pillars.
